full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 32
Federal
Nepal
Daily Agenda
Parliament,
Wednesday, Ashar 24, 2083
11:00 AM
Information on Message
1. The Secretary of the House of Representatives, Mr. Prakash Adhikari, will provide information on the message received from the National Assembly regarding the "Appropriation Bill, 2083".
Presentation of Annual Reports
2. On behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister Balendra Shah, the Honourable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam:
(a) Will present the "Annual Report of the Attorney General 2081/2082".
(b) Will present the "Thirty-fifth Annual Report of the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority 2081/2082".
Management Work
3. On behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister Balendra Shah, the Honourable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam:
(a) Will present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "National Service Corps Bill, 2083".
(b) Will introduce the "National Service Corps Bill, 2083".
(c) Will present a proposal for consideration of the "Bill to Revive the Previous Provisions of the Nepal Special Service Act, 2042, 2083".
4. The Honourable Minister for Finance, Dr. Swarnim Wagle, will present a proposal to send the "Nepal Rastra Bank (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083" to the relevant committee for clause-by-clause discussion.
5. The Honourable Minister for Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation, Khadga Raj Poudel, will present a proposal to send the "Tourism Bill, 2082", originating in the National Assembly, to the relevant committee for clause-by-clause discussion.
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
